question: Who has been crowned Femina Miss India World 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nandini Gupta**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nandini Gupta was crowned **Femina Miss India World 2023**, representing the state of Rajasthan.
 
• She pursued her bachelor's degree in **Business Management** from Lala Lajpat Rai College, located in Mumbai.
 
• Nandini Gupta was born and raised **in Kota,** a city known for its educational institutions in Rajasthan.
 
• She cites Ratan Tata, the renowned Indian industrialist and philanthropist, as one of her major inspirations.
 
• After winning the Miss India title, Nandini will represent India at the prestigious Miss World 2023 competition, carrying forward India's legacy on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thounaojam Strela Luwang**

 
 
• Thounaojam Strela Luwang is Femina Miss India 2023 1st runner-up.
 
• She hails from Manipur, a state in northeastern India.
 
• Strela Luwang is known for her passion for social causes and actively advocates for mental health awareness.
 
 
 
• ** Femina Miss India World** 
 
 
• Femina Miss India World is one of the most esteemed beauty pageants in India, organized annually by **The Times Group.**
 
• The** winner of Femina Miss India World represents India at the Miss World competition**, showcasing talent, beauty, and cultural heritage on an international platform.
 
• Many former winners, such as **Priyanka Chopra, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, and Sushmita Sen,** have gone on to achieve significant success in both national and international arenas, including acting and philanthropy.
